summary: Bound Ord indexing batches and stop USDB services before waiting for Ord
details: Default Ord commit interval is 100 blocks instead of 5000; explicit operator overrides remain effective.

Explicit automatic resource setup/recalculation enables a larger bounded Ord catch-up allocation, preserving Core budgets, the system reserve and BH's steady minimum. The supervisor selects catch-up or steady application cache using sustained live chain observations and clean Ord-only restarts; container ceilings remain reserved for file cache and future catch-up.

Node shutdown stops control-plane, chain, indexer and BH before waiting indefinitely for Ord's clean database commit, keeping Bitcoin available until Ord exits. Progress distinguishes client wait from supervisor shutdown time and shows the commit target.
operator_actions: Update both the node kit and services image after a clean shutdown. A currently running Ord process keeps its original batch size until restarted.

To opt an existing automatic configuration into adaptive Ord budgets, stop the node and run usdb-node set-resource-policy --mode auto --ord-memory-cap 32g, then inspect resources and doctor before up. Custom memory caps and explicit ORD_COMMIT_INTERVAL values are preserved unless changed.
